---
name: Feature Request / Spec Proposal
about: Suggest an idea or new capability for the AI Engineering harness
title: "[FEAT]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "spec-proposal"]
assignees: ""
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you are proposing.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
What problem does this solve? How does it help curb "vibe coding" or improve deterministic AI engineering?

## Proposed OpenSpec Alignment
- [ ] New OpenSpec Specification (`openspec/specs/<name>/spec.md`)
- [ ] New OpenSpec Change Proposal (`openspec/changes/<name>/`)
- [ ] Extension to existing Path Policy (`scripts/path-policy.json`)
- [ ] Extension to Gate Validation rules (`scripts/verify-gates.*`)

## Detailed Design & Alternatives Considered
Describe the proposed design, API changes, or CLI ergonomics. What alternatives have you considered?

## Verification Plan (TDD / Replay)
How will this feature be verified following strict TDD causality (`test(red)` -> `feat(green)`) and automated regression testing?
